data.title: 英梨梨 · 画室地板上的散发草图
data.description: 深夜的工作室内满地散落着画稿与数位笔，英梨梨解开发带，平日高傲的双马尾金发如瀑布般散落在绿色运动服与榻榻米上。她趴在地板上托着下巴端详眼前的线稿，虎牙微露，白皙脸颊泛着专注微醺的红晕，完全卸下了傲娇大小姐的防线。
data.location: artist studio with drawings scattered across tatami and digital tablet
data.action: lying on stomach on studio floor surrounded by sketches, hair untied falling over shoulders, tracksuit unzipped, touching pen to lips, blushing
data.lighting: soft directional warm desk lamp casting dramatic shadows on sketches
data.mood: unguarded creative vulnerability, sweet tsundere surrender
data.promptProse: Lying on her stomach amidst scattered illustration drafts on the studio floor, Eriri lets her golden hair flow loose over a casual green tracksuit. She taps a stylus to her lips with an unguarded, adorable blush.
data.animaCaption: Eriri lying on the floor surrounded by drawings with loose golden hair, blushing softly.
